title: The Drive That Starts OVER 🚗
description:
On our mountain road, there's one question you never ask in the car. Ask it, and the whole drive starts over from mile one.

Every winter Mom drives my big sister and me up to the little cabin we rent. This year we've passed the same snowy pine thirty-seven times, and neither of us has said a word.

It's made up. A blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Comment YET if you'd have asked it on purpose.
